_comment: Review details for the OpenAI plugin portal (filled in the dashboard on 8 Oct 2026). Positive cases: prompts that should trigger a tool. Negative cases, in OpenAI's meaning: prompts where the plugin must NOT trigger even though the model might think it is relevant. No test account is needed: the server has no sign-in.

review.demo_recording_url: TODO: record a 2-minute walkthrough in ChatGPT developer mode and paste the URL

positive.description: Cost range from two cities. The tool resolves the distance from stored route data and returns a labelled research range with the calculator URL.
positive.prompt: Using Haulest, what would it cost to move a 2-bedroom from Austin, TX to Denver, CO?
positive.expected_behavior: One call to estimate_moving_cost with homeSize 2bed, from Austin, to Denver. The answer gives a low and high in USD, says it is a research planning range as of September 2026 and not a bid, mentions about 930 miles, and links to haulest.com/calculators/cost.

positive.description: Reviewed movers near a city, then one profile.
positive.prompt: Who are the best-reviewed movers in Denver on Haulest? Open the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: find_movers with place Denver returns companies with average rating, review count, newest review date, USDOT, and a haulest.com/movers URL. get_mover_profile for the first slug returns the rating, three newest reviews, licence identifiers with the FMCSA authority summary, and the company phone from a public record.

positive.prompt: Check USDOT 3391195 on Haulest before I pay a deposit.
positive.expected_behavior: check_mover_licence with query 3391195 returns the FMCSA census record (legal name, place, status, whether household goods is listed), the authority and insurance summary when available, the official SAFER URL, and the Haulest profile URL if one exists.

positive.prompt: From Haulest: the guide on binding versus non-binding estimates, and the 8-week moving checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: search_moving_guides returns matching guide titles with a one-paragraph answer and URLs; get_moving_checklist with list 8-week returns the sections and items plus the printable URL.

positive.description: Quote request with consent. The model confirms details and consent before calling; the server answers with a reference and what happens next.
positive.prompt: I want written quotes for my 3-bedroom move from Phoenix, AZ to Denver, CO on 2026-12-05. My name is Test Person, phone +1 555 010 0100, email test.person@example.com. Yes, I agree that Haulest may share this with licensed movers who will call and email me.
positive.expected_behavior: One call to request_moving_quotes with consent true. The answer gives a short request reference, says the Haulest desk will call, gives the Haulest number +1 (866) 961-9682 for changes, and says movers will follow up, and links the privacy page. A second identical prompt within a day returns the same reference marked as already received, not a new request.

negative.description: The word move is about a spreadsheet, not a home. Haulest must not trigger.
negative.prompt: How do I move a column to the front of my Excel sheet without breaking the formulas?

negative.description: Moving average in finance. Nothing to do with relocation; Haulest must not trigger.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a 50-day and a 200-day moving average for a stock.

negative.description: Emotional writing task about a friend relocating. No cost, mover, licence, or quote need; Haulest must not trigger.
negative.prompt: Write a short, warm goodbye card for my coworker who is moving to another city next week.
